name: Gunslinger
status: draft; every number is a placeholder for playtesting
identity: Fast, cheap and loud. Pays in omen instead of gold. Ammo returns to the shop after firing.

ability.name: Deadeye
ability.text: Once per round, draw the bottom card of your deck.

kit.name: Revolver
kit.text: Starts in play. Once per round, when you would return a Bullet to your shop, tuck it under this card instead (max 2 tucked). You may play a tucked Bullet as if it were in your hand. When a tucked Bullet is played, it returns to your shop.

signatureCards.name: Standard Round
signatureCards.text: Deal 2 damage to a board card.

signatureCards.name: Hollow Point
signatureCards.text: Deal 3 damage to a board card.

signatureCards.name: Scattershot
signatureCards.text: Deal 1 damage to each of up to 3 board cards.

signatureCards.name: Silver Round
signatureCards.text: Deal 5 damage to a board card.

signatureCards.name: Warning Shot
signatureCards.text: Cancel a Hazard as it would resolve.

signatureCards.name: Bandolier
signatureCards.text: Once per round, when you draw from the bottom of your deck, look at the bottom 3 cards and draw one of them instead.

signatureCards.name: Quick Draw
signatureCards.text: Draw 2 cards from the bottom of your deck.

signatureCards.name: Fan the Hammer
signatureCards.text: Play up to 2 Bullets from your hand. Each one that deals damage deals 1 extra damage.

signatureCards.name: Duck and Cover
signatureCards.text: Prevent up to 2 damage from an Attack.

signatureCards.name: Wanted Poster
signatureCards.text: Choose a board card. Bullets deal 1 extra damage to it until the end of the round.

upgrades.name: Peacemaker
upgrades.text: Starts in play when upgraded. Once per round, when you would return a Bullet to your shop, tuck it under this card instead (max 3 tucked). You may play a tucked Bullet as if it were in your hand. When a tucked Bullet is played, it returns to your shop.

upgrades.name: Ammo Belt
upgrades.text: Once per round, when you draw from the bottom of your deck, look at the bottom 5 cards and draw one of them instead.

upgrades.name: Explosive Round
upgrades.text: Deal 3 damage to a board card and 1 damage to another board card.

upgrades.name: Lightning Draw
upgrades.text: Draw 3 cards from the bottom of your deck.

upgrades.name: Dodge Roll
upgrades.text: Prevent up to 3 damage from an Attack.

notes: The Revolver is a kit card and is not part of the 20. Entity effects that discard items (for example Foundering Boat) can still hit it. Needs a rule.
Deadeye, Bandolier and Quick Draw exist because shop purchases go to the bottom of the deck. They are how the Gunslinger reaches the bullets they just bought.
Fired Bullets return to the shop, not the discard pile, so the Gunslinger's deck empties faster. That means more deck-out omen.
Upgrades sit outside the 40. Open: can a Bullet that is in the shop be upgraded, or only cards in deck, hand or discard?
